prompt.en: What have poets and songwriters called Canada?
prompt.fr: Comment les poètes et les auteurs-compositeurs ont-ils appelé le Canada?

explanation.en: Canadians built a prosperous society in a rugged land that runs from the Atlantic to the Pacific and up to the Arctic Circle. Poets and songwriters have called the country the Great Dominion.
explanation.fr: Les Canadiens ont bâti une société prospère dans un pays rude qui s'étend de l'Atlantique au Pacifique et jusqu'au cercle arctique. Les poètes et les auteurs-compositeurs ont appelé le pays le Grand Dominion.

source.quote: poets and songwriters have hailed Canada as the “Great Dominion.”

verification.evidence: from our Atlantic shores to the Pacific Ocean and to the Arctic Circle—so much so that poets and songwriters have hailed Canada as the “Great Dominion.”
